scenario.outcome: The solo player gathered Echoes, deposited exactly three into the archive, selected Moss, activated both plates, and reached one restoration. The HUD then showed archive charge reset to 0/3 and Restorations 1.

Collected Echoes through server-accepted ProximityPrompt input; server inventory increased and the collected item lost its SignalGardenEcho tag.
Deposited Echoes at the archive; the HUD advanced from 1/3 to 2/3 to 3/3.
Selected Moss and activated MossSwitchA and MossSwitchB within the route window.
Observed the client report Habitat restored, then the archive reset to 0/3 with one restoration.
Stopped Play and verified Studio returned to Edit; no save or publish occurred.
scenario.firstAttempt: A separately issued Moss route attempt expired and returned to route choice while the archive remained charged. The second sequence was issued as a single bounded tool batch and passed.
scenario.console: Only the expected [Signal Garden] Cooperative marsh loop started line was returned.
